blockingFindings.title: An approved evidence root can itself symlink outside the repository
blockingFindings.finding: resolveRepoEvidencePath rejects a symlinked evidence file but accepts a candidate under an approved root directory that is itself a symlink to an external directory. The implementation resolves the approved root and then checks the candidate relative to that external real path; it never proves that the real approved root is inside the real repository root.
evidence: scripts/lib/repo-evidence-path.mjs:24-31 computes realApprovedRoot and realRelative but does not compare realApprovedRoot with realpath(repoRoot).
scripts/tests/eval-contract.test.mjs:157-167 tests an approved/capture.log symlink, not an approved-root symlink.

A read-only temporary probe made approved a symlink to an external directory; resolveRepoEvidencePath(base, 'approved/private.log', ['approved']) returned a path and relative value instead of an error.
blockingFindings.impact: Retained deterministic command or review evidence can be read from or written through an external location, defeating the asserted repository-root boundary and creating a path for stale, fabricated, or protected evidence to participate in certification.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Resolve the real repository root and reject any allowed root whose real path is not contained by it before validating the candidate. Add a regression fixture in which the approved root itself is a symlink to an external directory, then rerun the eval-contract tests and the governed checks on the unchanged candidate.
